links.outcome: Newly diagnosed low EF within 30 days after ECG, AI-ECG alerts versus standard care
links.effect: Detection rose 1.5% vs 1.1% (HR 1.50, 95% CI 1.11-2.03, P=0.023); high-risk patients 13.0% vs 8.9% (HR 1.55); echocardiogram use unchanged (17.1% vs 17.3%).
links.quote: The intervention significantly increased the detection of newly diagnosed low EF in the overall cohort (1.5% vs. 1.1%, HR 1.50, 95% CI: 1.11-2.03, P = 0.023), with a more pronounced effect among AI-identified high-risk patients (13.0% vs. 8.9%, HR 1.55, 95% CI: 1.08-2.21).

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial testing real-world deployment of an AI-ECG clinical decision support alert compared to standard care on clinical outcomes.

primary.practice: AI-assisted clinical decision support alerts in EHR
